existing.description: The UTS Vice-Chancellor's International Undergraduate Scholarship supports high-achieving commencing international students enrolling in an undergraduate program at UTS in Sydney. The value is UTS tuition fees for the standard duration of the course. Applicants must remain an international student, meet UTS admission criteria for their chosen undergraduate program by the scholarship closing date, commence full-time on-campus study in Sydney, have completed an Australian Year 12 or comparable high school qualification within three years before commencing at UTS and be admitted on that basis, and hold an overall average of 85% where the pass mark is 50%. The scholarship is awarded to the highest ranked applicant on academic merit in the admission qualification combined with their responses in the UTS online scholarship application. For the Autumn session 2027 (February 2027 commencement) the application period runs from Thursday 1 October 2026 to Monday 2 November 2026 at 11.55pm AEST.
eligibility: Remain an international student (not an Australian citizen, New Zealand citizen or permanent resident of Australia)
Meet UTS admission criteria for the selected UTS undergraduate program by the closing date of the scholarship application
Commence full-time studies and on campus (Sydney)

Have completed an Australian Year 12 or high school studies comparable to an Australian Year 12 outside Australia within three years prior to commencing at UTS, and be admitted based on this qualification
Have an overall average of 85% where the pass mark is 50%, or equivalent, in a UTS-recognised high school qualification
Apply using the UTS online Scholarships Application form
Not be studying a UTS online degree or distance mode degree
Not be a recipient of other UTS International Grants or Scholarships, unless approved by exception and outlined in the Conditions of Award
